sources.quote: Trespassing deaths, in particular, have nearly doubled on a per-train-mile basis since 2015 after over a decade of stability.
sources.searcher_note: National pattern: trespass deaths nearly doubled per train-mile since 2015. No per-railroad breakdown, so Union Pacific is not named. Date is as reported by the fetch tool for this version.

sources.quote: Union Pacific has reported a 24 percent decrease in personal injuries across its rail network in 2025
sources.searcher_note: Local story on a fatal pedestrian strike by a UP train, 'at least the fourth' in the Sacramento area in about a year. The UP safety claim is about personal injuries (a different measure), not trespasser deaths.

notes: No source found that reports Union Pacific's trespasser deaths rising (79 to 156 a year) or compares UP to other railroads in the same counties. Coverage found is national (CRS: trespass deaths nearly doubled per train-mile since 2015; FRA/Operation Lifesaver state tallies) or single-incident local news naming UP trains.
